sentences.en: So, people on my street would have to walk by and see that homes near us had the new green bin and we didn't.
sentences.zh: 所以，我这条街上的人走过时，会看到附近的住户已经有了新绿色垃圾桶，而我们还没有。

sentences.en: And you'd sort of be thinking on your walk to the subway to go to work, like, the hell, where's my bin?
sentences.zh: 当你走去地铁站上班时，你心里会想：搞什么鬼，我的垃圾桶呢？

sentences.en: But eventually, Amy did get a bin of her own.
sentences.zh: 但最终，艾米还是得到了属于自己的垃圾桶。

sentences.en: So, on the lid, there is a dial, like a handle, that you turn.
sentences.zh: 在盖子上有一个拨盘，就像一个把手，你可以转动它。

sentences.en: And when it's in the horizontal position, it's open.
sentences.zh: 当它处于水平位置时，它是打开的。

sentences.en: When it's in the vertical position, it's secured.
sentences.zh: 当它处于垂直位置时，它是锁定的。

sentences.en: It's locked.
sentences.zh: 它被锁住了。

sentences.en: You actually have to turn it in a way that really would make it difficult, if not impossible, to turn if you don't have opposable thumbs.
sentences.zh: 你实际上必须以一种特定的方式转动它，如果没有对生拇指，转动起来会非常困难，甚至是不可能的。

sentences.en: And contrary to popular belief, raccoons don't have opposable thumbs, even though they can move the thumb-like digit on their creepy little hands a little bit.
sentences.zh: 与普遍看法相反，浣熊并没有对生拇指，尽管它们那毛骨悚然的小手上那个类似拇指的指头确实能动一点点。

sentences.en: In any case, for a while, everything seemed to be going according to plan.
sentences.zh: 无论如何，有一段时间，一切似乎都按计划进行。

sentences.en: In fact, some people were worried that the new bins were working too well.
sentences.zh: 事实上，有些人担心新垃圾桶的效果太好了。

sentences.en: In other words, people were afraid that without the green bins as a food source, maybe the raccoons were starving.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，人们担心没有了绿色垃圾桶作为食物来源，浣熊可能会饿死。

sentences.en: So, the way I became involved in all of this was that in January of 2018,
sentences.zh: 我参与到这一切中的原因在于，2018 年 1 月，

sentences.en: a friend sent me a note saying that he believed the new green bins had eliminated the raccoon population in Toronto.
sentences.zh: 一位朋友给我发了条信息，说他认为多伦多的浣熊种群已经被新绿色垃圾桶消灭了。

sentences.en: He actually used the word eliminated.
sentences.zh: 他用的词确实是“消灭”。

sentences.en: As any intrepid reporter would do, Amy decided to look into it.
sentences.zh: 作为一名无畏的记者，艾米决定一探究竟。

sentences.en: I wrote a quick email to Suzanne McDonald, our local raccoon expert, and I said, hey, could the raccoons be dying?
sentences.zh: 我给当地的浣熊专家苏珊·麦克唐纳写了一封简短的邮件，我说，嘿，浣熊会死掉吗？

sentences.en: And she just said, eh, they're probably hiding from the cold.
sentences.zh: 她只是说，呃，它们可能是在躲避寒冷。

sentences.en: But, she said, she would have more information in a few months.
sentences.zh: 但她说，几个月后她会有更多信息。

sentences.en: She said, after I measure more dead raccoons.
sentences.zh: 她说，等我测量完更多死掉的浣熊之后。

sentences.en: So, I, of course, wrote back immediately and said, can I come?
sentences.zh: 于是，我当然立刻回信说，我可以去吗？

sentences.en: Animal control was collecting raccoons killed by cars and storing them in freezers for Suzanne,
sentences.zh: 动物管制部门会收集被车撞死的浣熊，并把它们存放在冷冻库里给苏珊，

sentences.en: who would then come in and measure them in order to track the health of the population from year to year.
sentences.zh: 然后她会去测量它们，以便逐年追踪该种群的健康状况。

sentences.en: And I do this four times a year.
sentences.zh: 我每年做四次这项工作。

sentences.en: And when you go in July, it turns out, and you bring out frozen raccoon carcasses, and it takes a while to measure them, they start to melt.
sentences.zh: 当你七月份去的时候，把冷冻的浣熊尸体拿出来，测量它们需要一段时间，它们就开始融化了。

sentences.en: Oh, dear God.
sentences.zh: 噢，天哪。

sentences.en: You can imagine the maggots and the blood and the, all the things.
sentences.zh: 你可以想象那些蛆虫、血迹，还有所有那些东西。

sentences.en: But that's fine.
sentences.zh: 但没关系。

sentences.en: And, I mean, this is science.
sentences.zh: 我是说，这就是科学。

sentences.en: We push through.
sentences.zh: 我们坚持下去。

sentences.en: Suzanne wouldn't have the results of her data for a while.
sentences.zh: 苏珊还要过一阵子才能得出数据结果。

sentences.en: But while Amy was there watching her measure dead raccoons, she asked her.
sentences.zh: 但当艾米在那里看着她测量死浣熊时，她问了她一个问题。

sentences.en: Do you think it's possible they could learn how to get into the new green bins?
sentences.zh: 你认为它们有可能学会如何进入新绿色垃圾桶吗？

sentences.en: And she shook her head no.
sentences.zh: 她摇了摇头，表示不会。

sentences.en: She said, you know, she'd filmed them trying, and not one of them could do it.
sentences.zh: 她说，你知道，她拍过它们尝试的视频，没有一只能够做到。

sentences.en: She just said, they won't, they won't get in.
sentences.zh: 她只是说，它们不会，它们进不去的。

sentences.en: The raccoons won't break into these green bins.
sentences.zh: 浣熊是不会闯入这些绿色垃圾桶的。

sentences.en: There is no such thing as a raccoon-proof green bin.
sentences.zh: 根本不存在所谓的“防浣熊”绿色垃圾桶。

sentences.en: And Toronto spent a lot of money on the raccoon-proof green bins.
sentences.zh: 而多伦多在这些防浣熊绿色垃圾桶上花了很多钱。

sentences.en: And this was video that was put out yesterday.
sentences.zh: 这是昨天发布的一段视频。

sentences.en: I saw it come out.
sentences.zh: 我看到它发布了。

sentences.en: Then about a week later, this story comes out.
sentences.zh: 大约一周后，这个故事就出来了。

sentences.en: And so look to your left.
sentences.zh: 所以，往你的左边看。

sentences.en: So watch as they'll zoom into it here.
sentences.zh: 看着，他们会在这里放大画面。

sentences.en: Hold on.
sentences.zh: 等等。

sentences.en: It's basically a local Toronto resident who has filmed the video of a raccoon opening his green bin.
sentences.zh: 这基本上是一位多伦多当地居民拍摄的视频，记录了一只浣熊打开了他的绿色垃圾桶。

sentences.en: Let's give that a little tug.
sentences.zh: 让我们稍微拉一下。

sentences.en: There we go.
sentences.zh: 这就对了。

sentences.en: Something smells good.
sentences.zh: 有什么东西闻起来很香。

sentences.en: And just like kind of winking at the camera almoSt.
sentences.zh: 而且几乎就像是在对着镜头眨眼一样。

sentences.en: Really?
sentences.zh: 真的吗？

sentences.en: This was not the only report of a bin being broken into, although it was the first to include video, which quickly went viral,
sentences.zh: 这并不是唯一关于垃圾桶被闯入的报告，尽管它是第一个包含视频的，而且视频很快就疯传了，

sentences.en: much to the dismay of Dennis Monastier from Rarig Pacific.
sentences.zh: 这让 Rarick Pacific 的丹尼斯·莫纳斯蒂尔非常沮丧。

sentences.en: For somebody just to come out and say, oh, the container doesn't work, you know, is frustrating.
sentences.zh: 有人直接跳出来说，哦，这个容器没用，你知道，这很令人沮丧。

sentences.en: The videos, Dennis says, don't tell the whole story.
sentences.zh: 丹尼斯说，这些视频并不能说明全部情况。

sentences.en: A couple of break-ins doesn't mean the design is flawed.
sentences.zh: 几次闯入并不意味着设计有缺陷。

sentences.en: The screw might be loosened too much.
sentences.zh: 螺丝可能拧得太松了。

sentences.en: And if you just simply tighten it a little bit, it might prevent the issue.
sentences.zh: 如果你只是稍微拧紧一点，可能就能解决这个问题。

sentences.en: Dennis is frustrated by the fact that sometimes when people have issues with their green bins, they don't call the city.
sentences.zh: 丹尼斯感到沮丧的是，有时人们在使用绿色垃圾桶遇到问题时，他们并不给市政厅打电话。

sentences.en: They don't report their issues to 311.
sentences.zh: 他们不向 311 报告他们的问题。

sentences.en: Instead, they sometimes call the local newspaper and then it becomes a story.
sentences.zh: 相反，他们有时会给当地报纸打电话，然后这就成了一个新闻故事。

sentences.en: I think he said something to me like, you know, when your car breaks down, you don't call the Toronto Star.
sentences.zh: 我想他对我说了类似这样的话，你知道，当你的车坏了，你不会给《多伦多星报》打电话。

sentences.en: You call the mechanic.
sentences.zh: 你会给修理工打电话。

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: For some reason, you know, Toronto specifically, they love to glamorize raccoons.
sentences.zh: 出于某种原因，你知道，多伦多特别喜欢美化浣熊。

sentences.en: The city, for its part, blamed the handful of break-ins on user error.
sentences.zh: 市政厅方面则将少数几起闯入事件归咎于用户操作失误。

sentences.en: And the city's response was to suggest that these homeowners weren't locking their bins properly.
sentences.zh: 市政厅的回应是暗示这些房主没有正确锁好他们的垃圾桶。

sentences.en: And to emphasize, they had only had a handful of complaints out of 450,000 green bins.
sentences.zh: 并强调，在 45 万个绿色垃圾桶中，他们只收到了寥寥几起投诉。

sentences.en: The suggestion being that if Joe in Yorkville had a problem with his bin.
sentences.zh: 暗示的意思是，如果约克维尔的乔遇到了垃圾桶的问题。

sentences.en: Then maybe the problem was Joe and not the bin.
sentences.zh: 那么问题可能出在乔身上，而不是垃圾桶身上。

sentences.en: So, soon after, I woke up one morning and walked outside and saw that my neighbor's green bin was on the ground in our laneway.
sentences.zh: 所以，不久之后，一天早上我醒来走到外面，看到邻居的绿色垃圾桶倒在我们的小巷里。

sentences.en: And there was food everywhere.
sentences.zh: 到处都是食物。

sentences.en: So, I texted my neighbor and said, the raccoons have gotten into your green bin.
sentences.zh: 所以我给邻居发了短信说，浣熊钻进你的绿色垃圾桶了。

sentences.en: She said, you know, what the hell?
sentences.zh: 她说，你知道，搞什么鬼？

sentences.en: Can the raccoons get into the green bins now?
sentences.zh: 浣熊现在能钻进绿色垃圾桶了吗？

sentences.en: At this point, Amy had been convinced by the city's argument.
sentences.zh: 此时，艾米已经被市政厅的论点说服了。

sentences.en: There was no problem with the bins.
sentences.zh: 垃圾桶没有问题。

sentences.en: The problem was the users.
sentences.zh: 问题出在用户身上。

sentences.en: I wrote back and said, more likely that you didn't lock it properly.
sentences.zh: 我回信说，更有可能是你没锁好。

sentences.en: I still have the text message, and when I read it, I cringe a little bit.
sentences.zh: 那条短信我至今还留着，当我读到它时，我感到有点尴尬。

sentences.en: It's like, no, I don't think you locked it properly, Caroline.
sentences.zh: 就像是，不，我不认为你锁好了，卡罗琳。

sentences.en: But Amy didn't get to stay smug for long.
sentences.zh: 但艾米没能得意太久。

sentences.en: Two nights later, her own bin was plundered.
sentences.zh: 两天后，她自己的垃圾桶也被洗劫了。

sentences.en: My husband and I get a group text message from Caroline.
sentences.zh: 我和我丈夫收到了卡罗琳发来的群发短信。

sentences.en: The raccoons have gotten into your green bin.
sentences.zh: 浣熊钻进你们的绿色垃圾桶了。

sentences.en: At this point, I'm floored because my husband is a person who locks things and checks locks like seven times.
sentences.zh: 那一刻，我惊呆了，因为我丈夫是一个会锁好东西并检查锁七次的人。

sentences.en: It seemed the reporter had just become a character in her own story.
sentences.zh: 看来这位记者已经成了自己故事里的一个角色。

sentences.en: I'm thinking, like, first of all, do they, like, this is so weird.
sentences.zh: 我在想，首先，它们，这太奇怪了。

sentences.en: Did they know that I was looking into this stuff, you know?
sentences.zh: 它们知道我在调查这些东西吗，你知道吗？

sentences.en: Am I being targeted?
sentences.zh: 我是被盯上了吗？

sentences.en: Amy called the city who said, ma'am, please, you probably just have a broken handle.
sentences.zh: 艾米给市政厅打了电话，对方说，女士，拜托，你可能只是把把手弄坏了。

sentences.en: And they sent some workers out to fix it.
sentences.zh: 于是他们派了一些工人去修理。

sentences.en: And they replaced the lid on my bin as a precaution, even though they couldn't find anything wrong with it.
sentences.zh: 他们作为预防措施更换了我垃圾桶的盖子，尽管他们没发现有什么问题。

sentences.en: She also wrote to the raccoon expert, Suzanne McDonald, who was thrilled because she's always secretly been on Team Raccoon.
sentences.zh: 她还写信给了浣熊专家苏珊·麦克唐纳，苏珊非常激动，因为她一直暗中支持“浣熊战队”。

sentences.en: She wrote back almost immediately and said, that is awesome.
sentences.zh: 她几乎立刻回信说，那太棒了。

sentences.en: And she said, I'm going to loan you a trail camera, and you have to see how they're doing it.
sentences.zh: 她说，我要借给你一个野外摄像机，你必须看看它们是怎么做到的。

sentences.en: So I get the camera from Suzanne.
sentences.zh: 于是我从苏珊那里拿到了摄像机。

sentences.en: We meet up at the zoo one day.
sentences.zh: 有一天我们在动物园见面。

sentences.en: I go to our local grocery store and I get a couple of chickens, put the chicken in the green bin, rubbed some of the chicken grease all over the green bin.
sentences.zh: 我去当地的杂货店买了些鸡肉，把鸡肉放进绿色垃圾桶里，还在垃圾桶上抹了一些鸡油。

sentences.en: The first night, raccoons did not come.
sentences.zh: 第一天晚上，浣熊没来。

sentences.en: The second night, I went out to the front porch, actually with my toddler.
sentences.zh: 第二天晚上，我带着我蹒跚学步的孩子走到前廊。

sentences.en: We peeked around the corner, and my daughter said, uh-oh.
sentences.zh: 我们从拐角处偷看，我女儿说，噢噢。

sentences.en: The bin was down.
sentences.zh: 垃圾桶倒了。

sentences.en: It was a mess.
sentences.zh: 一片狼藉。

sentences.en: I took the camera upstairs and pressed play on the video that I captured.
sentences.zh: 我把摄像机带到楼上，按下了我拍摄的视频的播放键。

sentences.en: It's almost as though the raccoons knew what I was doing, and they were like, let's give her a really good shot here.
sentences.zh: 简直就像浣熊知道我在做什么一样，它们好像在说，让我们给她拍个好镜头吧。

sentences.en: This one is going to go viral.
sentences.zh: 这个视频肯定会火。

sentences.en: The camera is pointing at the bins, and then all of a sudden this mama raccoon comes skulking out, and she just pulls the bin down.
sentences.zh: 摄像机对着垃圾桶，突然，这只浣熊妈妈鬼鬼祟祟地出来，直接把垃圾桶拉倒了。

sentences.en: And she gets out of the way.
sentences.zh: 然后她闪到一边。

sentences.en: At this point, you can tell she knows what she's doing.
sentences.zh: 此时，你可以看出她知道自己在做什么。

sentences.en: She's not going to stand in the way and get crushed by the bin.
sentences.zh: 她不会站在那里被垃圾桶压到。

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 不会的。

sentences.en: She's going to pull it at the exact right angle, and it just falls down with like a bang, and turns around and looks at the camera as if to say, watch this.
sentences.zh: 她会以恰到好处的角度拉动它，垃圾桶砰的一声倒下，她转过身看着镜头，仿佛在说，看好了。

sentences.en: And then she turns the handle and just turns it.
sentences.zh: 然后她转动把手，就这样转开了。

sentences.en: Yoink!
sentences.zh: 嘿咻！

sentences.en: Opens it just like I would, and in they go.
sentences.zh: 像我一样打开它，然后它们就进去了。

sentences.en: The key seemed to be knocking down the bin, which made the handle much easier to turn.
sentences.zh: 关键似乎在于把垃圾桶撞倒，这让把手更容易转动。

sentences.en: When it's on the ground, you can just kind of pull on it, like as if you're pulling a lever.
sentences.zh: 当它在地上时，你可以直接拉它，就像拉杠杆一样。

sentences.en: You know, you can almost bat your paws at it or like pull it to the side.
sentences.zh: 你知道，你几乎可以用爪子拍打它，或者把它拉向一边。

sentences.en: On August 30th, 2018, Amy published an article in the Toronto Star with her video.
sentences.zh: 2018 年 8 月 30 日，艾米在《多伦多星报》上发表了一篇文章，并附上了她的视频。

sentences.en: And as these things tend to do in Toronto, it went viral.
sentences.zh: 正如多伦多的这类事情一样，它火了。

sentences.en: Thousands of Torontonians watched as the protagonist handily pulled down the bin,
sentences.zh: 成千上万的多伦多人看着这位主角熟练地拉倒垃圾桶，

sentences.en: and then, flashing her glowing eyes at the camera, showed off how easily she could open it.
sentences.zh: 然后，对着镜头闪烁着发光的眼睛，炫耀着她能多么轻松地打开它。

sentences.en: Amy got a bunch of emails and comments on the article, people saying that this was happening to them too.
sentences.zh: 艾米收到了很多关于这篇文章的邮件和评论，人们说这种情况也发生在他们身上。

sentences.en: But the city maintained they were getting relatively few complaints overall.
sentences.zh: 但市政厅坚持认为，总的来说，他们收到的投诉相对较少。

sentences.en: When Amy told Dennis Monasier from Raric Pacific that the raccoons were getting into the bin that his company designed,
sentences.zh: 当艾米告诉 Raric Pacific 的丹尼斯·莫纳斯蒂尔，浣熊正在钻进他公司设计的垃圾桶时，

sentences.en: he decided to pay her a house call.
sentences.zh: 他决定亲自上门拜访。

sentences.en: You know, I personally wanted to go out there myself to inspect the container
sentences.zh: 你知道，我个人想亲自去那里检查一下容器，

sentences.en: and to do some torque force testing on the handle itself.
sentences.zh: 并对把手本身进行一些扭矩力测试。

sentences.en: Some heroes don't wear capes.
sentences.zh: 有些英雄不穿斗篷。

sentences.en: They wear polo shirts with the company logo on the breast pocket.
sentences.zh: 他们穿着胸前口袋印有公司标志的 Polo 衫。

sentences.en: The day Dennis came over, my neighbor Mike came over as soon as he saw this guy in my driveway working on the green bin.
sentences.zh: 丹尼斯过来的那天，我的邻居迈克一看到这个人在我的车道上修理绿色垃圾桶，就立刻过来了。

sentences.en: But Mike had no idea that this is the green bin guy.
sentences.zh: 但迈克不知道这就是“绿色垃圾桶先生”。

sentences.en: It seemed like there was a gang of neighbors that came up all of a sudden out of nowhere,
sentences.zh: 看起来好像有一群邻居突然从不知什么地方冒了出来，

sentences.en: and it was just like, oh, we have, you know, we have some problems with the raccoons getting into our bins.
sentences.zh: 他们就像是，哦，我们，你知道，我们遇到了一些浣熊钻进垃圾桶的问题。

sentences.en: They're getting into my bin, they're getting into everybody's bin,
sentences.zh: 它们钻进了我的垃圾桶，钻进了每个人的垃圾桶。

sentences.en: and he's just ripping on the green bins and the waste of money.
sentences.zh: 他一直在吐槽那些绿色垃圾桶和浪费钱的事。

sentences.en: Dennis took it all like a champ.
sentences.zh: 丹尼斯表现得非常大度。

sentences.en: He tightened up everyone's handles so they'd be particularly hard for a little raccoon paws to turn.
sentences.zh: 他把所有人的垃圾桶把手都拧紧了，这样小浣熊的爪子就很难转动了。

sentences.en: But it hasn't solved the problem.
sentences.zh: 但这并没有解决问题。

sentences.en: Having accepted defeat, Amy now keeps her bins tied to a wall so raccoons can't knock them over.
sentences.zh: 在承认失败后，艾米现在把垃圾桶绑在墙上，这样浣熊就推不倒它们了。

sentences.en: And she can't help but wonder how soon before this knowledge about how to open the bins spreads to the rest of Raccoon Nation.
sentences.zh: 她不禁想，这种如何打开垃圾桶的知识，还要多久才会传遍整个“浣熊国”。

sentences.en: Raccoons don't teach each other these things.
sentences.zh: 浣熊之间是不会互相传授这些技巧的。

sentences.en: It's called social learning, and even most monkeys don't do that.
sentences.zh: 这叫社会性学习，甚至大多数猴子都不会这样做。

sentences.en: And so it's not like this innovation is going to spread across the city.
sentences.zh: 所以，这种创新并不会在整个城市蔓延开来。

sentences.en: Suzanne McDonald doesn't think most raccoons in Toronto currently have what it takes to get into the new green compost bins,
sentences.zh: 苏珊·麦克唐纳认为，多伦多的大多数浣熊目前还不具备进入新型绿色堆肥桶的能力，

sentences.en: that perfect combination of strength, intelligence, and determination.
sentences.zh: 也就是那种力量、智慧和决心的完美结合。

sentences.en: Amy just happened to encounter an extra gifted one.
sentences.zh: 艾米只是碰巧遇到了一个格外有天赋的家伙。

sentences.en: We call her the genius raccoon because I think it's amazing that she did it.
sentences.zh: 我们叫她天才浣熊，因为我觉得她能做到这一点真是太神奇了。

sentences.en: Suzanne finally finished her dead raccoon study, and Toronto's favorite frenemy is as fat as ever.
sentences.zh: 苏珊终于完成了她的死浣熊研究，而多伦多最受欢迎的“宿敌”依然像往常一样肥硕。

sentences.en: She thinks that's because even though most of them can't get into the compost,
sentences.zh: 她认为这是因为，尽管它们中的大多数无法进入堆肥桶，

sentences.en: they've moved on to a different solution.
sentences.zh: 但它们已经转向了另一种解决方案。

sentences.en: The good old-fashioned garbage.
sentences.zh: 那就是老派的普通垃圾。

sentences.en: Our raccoons are not starving to death, that's for sure.
sentences.zh: 我们的浣熊肯定不会饿死，这一点毋庸置疑。

sentences.en: But she doesn't rule out that in a far-off future, we might end up creating an uber-raccoon.
sentences.zh: 但她并不排除在遥远的未来，我们最终可能会创造出一种“超级浣熊”。

sentences.en: One like Amy's that can get into just about anything.
sentences.zh: 就像艾米遇到的那种，几乎什么都能钻进去。

sentences.en: She's studied raccoons in cities, and they are, on the whole, smarter than their rural counterparts.
sentences.zh: 她研究过城市里的浣熊，总的来说，它们比农村的同类更聪明。

sentences.en: Urban raccoons are constantly having new problems placed in front of them to solve,
sentences.zh: 城市浣熊不断面临新的难题，需要它们去解决，

sentences.en: and they keep figuring them out.
sentences.zh: 而且它们总能想出办法。

sentences.en: And Suzanne and Dennis both tell people that the green bins were never advertised as raccoon-proof,
sentences.zh: 苏珊和丹尼斯都告诉人们，绿色垃圾桶从未被宣传为“防浣熊”，

sentences.en: only raccoon-resistant.
sentences.zh: 而只是“抗浣熊”。

sentences.en: Nothing is raccoon-proof, they say, which is a small concession that while the front of the line
sentences.zh: 他们说，没有什么东西是绝对防浣熊的，这是一个小小的让步，虽然目前防线

sentences.en: is holding for now, the war against raccoons continues.
sentences.zh: 还能守住，但针对浣熊的战争仍在继续。

sentences.en: After the break, more raccoon hijinks with Kurt Kolstad.
sentences.zh: 休息之后，库尔特·科尔斯塔德将带来更多关于浣熊的趣事。

sentences.en: If you listen to the show regularly, you know that Kurt Kolstad has a background in architecture.
sentences.zh: 如果你经常听这个节目，你就知道库尔特·科尔斯塔德有建筑学背景。

sentences.en: But if you also read the articles on our site, you probably also know that he's really into raccoons, too.
sentences.zh: 但如果你也读过我们网站上的文章，你可能也知道他其实也非常迷浣熊。

sentences.en: So when these two interests intersect, like, say, a raccoon going viral on the Internet
sentences.zh: 所以当这两个兴趣交织在一起时，比如，一只浣熊在互联网上走红，

sentences.en: for climbing up a downtown St. Paul office tower earlier this year, he was all over that story.
sentences.zh: 因为它今年早些时候爬上了圣保罗市中心的一座办公大楼，他立刻就关注了这个故事。

sentences.en: Oh, yeah, instantly.
sentences.zh: 哦，是的，立刻就关注了。

sentences.en: You know, the local news is there covering the story on the scene in Minnesota.
sentences.zh: 你知道，当地新闻就在明尼苏达州的现场报道这个故事。

sentences.en: But I'm out here, you know, researching the actual building that the raccoon is climbing,
sentences.zh: 但我当时在研究那只浣熊正在攀爬的实际建筑，

sentences.en: and I got super into it.
sentences.zh: 我对此超级着迷。

sentences.en: I was analyzing the facade and the materials.
sentences.zh: 我在分析外立面和建筑材料。

sentences.en: I started diagramming and then deconstructing the route that this raccoon took to the top.
sentences.zh: 我开始绘制图表，然后拆解这只浣熊爬到顶部的路线。

sentences.en: And so if you want, like, a straight-up Kennedy assassination-style deconstruction of that whole saga,
sentences.zh: 所以如果你想要那种像肯尼迪遇刺案调查风格的完整事件拆解，

sentences.en: you can check out our website.
sentences.zh: 你可以去我们的网站看看。

sentences.en: But before we get too far off track,
sentences.zh: 但在我们跑题太远之前，

sentences.en: Kurt is here today with the story of a different famous raccoon from nearly a century ago,
sentences.zh: 库尔特今天带来了近一个世纪前另一只著名浣熊的故事，

sentences.en: one that eventually resided in a particularly famous work of American architecture, the White House.
sentences.zh: 它最终住进了一座非常著名的美国建筑——白宫。

sentences.en: Oh, yes.
sentences.zh: 哦，是的。

sentences.en: History's not exactly full of famous raccoons,
sentences.zh: 历史上并不全是著名的浣熊，

sentences.en: but there's this one in particular that really stands out, especially around Thanksgiving.
sentences.zh: 但这一只特别引人注目，尤其是在感恩节前后。

sentences.en: Her name was Rebecca, and in 1926, she was sent to President Calvin Coolidge as a gift from a constituent in Mississippi.
sentences.zh: 她的名字叫丽贝卡，1926年，她作为密西西比州一位选民的礼物被送给了卡尔文·柯立芝总统。

sentences.en: But this raccoon wasn't meant to be a pet.
sentences.zh: 但这只浣熊原本并不是要当宠物的。

sentences.en: The idea was actually that she'd be served up as part of the holiday feaSt.
sentences.zh: 最初的想法是把她作为节日大餐的一部分端上桌。

sentences.en: Which is not the most traditional Thanksgiving meal.
sentences.zh: 这可不是最传统的感恩节大餐。

sentences.en: No, no.
sentences.zh: 不，不。

sentences.en: I mean, not today at leaSt.
sentences.zh: 我是说，至少现在不是。

sentences.en: But a century ago, wild animals were much more common to see on, you know, dinner plates.
sentences.zh: 但在一个世纪前，野生动物出现在餐桌上要常见得多。

sentences.en: Meals with duck or turtle or possum were pretty typical.
sentences.zh: 鸭子、海龟或负鼠做的菜都很典型。

sentences.en: And in some cases, there were even regional delicacies.
sentences.zh: 在某些情况下，甚至还有地区性的美味佳肴。

sentences.en: And then also, you know, sending animals as food to the White House for the holidays was a pretty popular tradition.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，在节日期间向白宫赠送动物作为食物也是一种很流行的传统。

sentences.en: So the president getting sent a raccoon wasn't maybe not that odd,
sentences.zh: 所以总统收到一只浣熊可能并不那么奇怪，

sentences.en: but him keeping him as a pet was out of the ordinary.
sentences.zh: 但他把她当作宠物养就非同寻常了。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I mean, that's a little bit more unusual.
sentences.zh: 我是说，那确实更不寻常一些。

sentences.en: When we think about presents and Thanksgiving,
sentences.zh: 当我们想到礼物和感恩节时，

sentences.en: we usually think of that turkey pardoning tradition.
sentences.zh: 我们通常会想到那个赦免火鸡的传统。

sentences.en: And that's about it.
sentences.zh: 仅此而已。

sentences.en: But for Coolidge, it wasn't that weird.
sentences.zh: 但对柯立芝来说，这并不奇怪。

sentences.en: He and his wife had tons of pets.
sentences.zh: 他和他的妻子养了大量的宠物。

sentences.en: They had cats and dogs and birds, of course, but also these really exotic ones.
sentences.zh: 他们有猫、狗和鸟，当然，还有一些非常珍奇的动物。

sentences.en: Over the years, they got wallabies and a bear, a pair of lion cubs, even a pygmy hippo.
sentences.zh: 多年来，他们收到过小袋鼠、一只熊、一对狮子幼崽，甚至还有一只侏儒河马。

sentences.en: Most of these, you know, as gifts, often from, you know, foreign dignitaries who knew that the Coolidges were really into weird animals.
sentences.zh: 其中大多数，你知道，都是作为礼物送的，通常来自知道柯立芝夫妇非常喜欢奇怪动物的外国政要。

sentences.en: But I'm still having a hard time picturing like a pygmy hippo running around the White House, though.
sentences.zh: 但我还是很难想象一只侏儒河马在白宫里跑来跑去的样子。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Well, some of them they, you know, re-gifted to zoos that could actually take care of them.
sentences.zh: 嗯，其中一些他们转赠给了能真正照顾它们的动物园。

sentences.en: But the Coolidges did keep a lot of them as pets, and they formed this kind of weird White House menagerie,
sentences.zh: 但柯立芝夫妇确实把很多动物留作宠物，他们组建了一个奇怪的白宫动物园，

sentences.en: or as one reporter called it, the Pennsylvania Avenue Zoo.
sentences.zh: 或者正如一位记者所称的那样，“宾夕法尼亚大道动物园”。

sentences.en: And so what about Rebecca, the raccoon?
sentences.zh: 那么那只浣熊丽贝卡呢？

sentences.en: Well, she became part of the first family, essentially.
sentences.zh: 嗯，她基本上成了第一家庭的一员。

sentences.en: Grace, the first lady, would walk her around on a leash during the day,
sentences.zh: 第一夫人格蕾丝白天会用皮带牵着她到处走，

sentences.en: and then at night, she'd curl up with Calvin on his lap next to the fireplace.
sentences.zh: 晚上，她会蜷缩在卡尔文的膝盖上，就在壁炉旁。

sentences.en: That sounds like a pretty good pet.
sentences.zh: 听起来是个很不错的宠物。

sentences.en: Well, yeah, I mean, that's one side of it.
sentences.zh: 嗯，是的，我是说，这是它的一面。

sentences.en: The other side is that she was still a wild animal,
sentences.zh: 另一面是她仍然是一只野生动物，

sentences.en: and she became kind of infamous for, you know, chewing her way out of her enclosures,
sentences.zh: 她因为咬坏围栏逃出来而变得有点“臭名昭著”，

sentences.en: and she'd wriggle out of the collars they put on her,
sentences.zh: 她会从他们给她戴的项圈里挣脱出来，

sentences.en: and she'd claw up the furniture in the White House.
sentences.zh: 还会抓坏白宫里的家具。

sentences.en: There's these stories of the Secret Service having to chase her around while she runs up trees.
sentences.zh: 有故事说特勤局不得不追着她跑，而她则爬上树。

sentences.en: And yeah, so she was a bit of a handful, too.
sentences.zh: 所以，她确实有点难管。

sentences.en: But, you know, she got to hang out in the White House sometimes,
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道，她有时可以在白宫里闲逛，

sentences.en: and the rest of the time she got this little wooden house that they put up for her on the South Lawn.
sentences.zh: 其余时间她住在他们在南草坪为她搭建的小木屋里。

sentences.en: So she's a little bit of a hassle, but she seemed to have a pretty sweet life, Rebecca, the raccoon.
sentences.zh: 所以她有点麻烦，但丽贝卡这只浣熊似乎过着相当甜蜜的生活。

sentences.en: Yeah, she did, and she lived with the Coolidge's for a while,
sentences.zh: 是的，她确实过得不错，她和柯立芝夫妇住了一段时间，

sentences.en: and then the first couple handed her off to a zoo.
sentences.zh: 后来第一夫妇把她送到了动物园。

sentences.en: And there were rumors at the time that maybe Rebecca bit Calvin
sentences.zh: 当时有传言说丽贝卡可能咬了卡尔文，

sentences.en: because one day he came out with a bandage on his hand.
sentences.zh: 因为有一天他出来时手上缠着绷带。

sentences.en: But Grace later wrote very fondly of this White House raccoon.
sentences.zh: 但格蕾丝后来非常深情地写到了这只白宫浣熊。

sentences.en: According to her, Rebecca, quote,
sentences.zh: 据她说，丽贝卡，引用她的话，

sentences.en: quote, enjoyed nothing better than being placed in a bathtub with a little water in it
sentences.zh: “最喜欢的事莫过于被放进装有少量水的浴缸里，

sentences.en: and given a cake of soap with which to play.
sentences.zh: 并给她一块肥皂玩耍。”

sentences.en: In this fashion, she would amuse herself for an hour or more.
sentences.zh: 就这样，她能自娱自乐一个小时甚至更久。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Thank you, Kurt.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，库尔特。

sentences.en: Oh, yeah, of course.
sentences.zh: 哦，不客气，当然。
